newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound stable against dollar - bankers.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound stable against dollar - bankers.

text.p: Bankers said the Egyptian pound remained stable against the dollar in the private-sector market on Thursday but one banker said the pound firmed fractionally due to an increase in the U.S. currency in the market.
The dollar ranged from 3.3940 to 3.3960 pounds bid and from 3.3965 to 3.3980 pounds offered in the interbank market, the bankers said.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3951 pounds bid and 3.3966 pound offered. These averages compare to 3.3953 pounds bid and 3.3970 pounds offered on Wednesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.392219 buy and 3.398217 sell.
